meta.title: Banka — Banki ya none y'ikoranabuhanga muri Afurika
meta.description: Banka ni urubuga rwa banki rucungwa n'ikoranabuhanga ruha abantu n'ibigo uburyo bwihuse, bwizewe kandi bworoshye bwo gucunga ubwishyu, kuzigama, kohereza amafaranga, no gukura mu by'amafaranga.

multiAccount.title: Ubuyobozi bwa konti nyinshi
multiAccount.desc: Fungura kandi ucunge konti zo kuzigama, zisanzwe n'iza fixed ahantu hamwe.

transfers.title: Kohereza ako kanya
transfers.desc: Ohereza amafaranga hagati ya konti zawe ako kanya kandi nta mafaranga y'inyongera.

roles.title: Umutekano ushingiye ku ruhare
roles.desc: Kugenzura kwinjira mu byiciro bitatu: abakiliya, abakoresha amafaranga, n'abayobozi.

audit.title: Amateka yuzuye
audit.desc: Buri gikorwa cyandikwa hamwe n'igihe n'umubare w'icyo gikorwa.

uptime.title: Kuboneka igihe cyose
uptime.desc: Geraho dashboard yawe ya banki igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, ahantu hose, ku gikoresho icyo ari cyo cyose.

encryption.title: Urwego rwa banki mu kubika amakuru
encryption.desc: Amakuru yawe arinzwe n'uburyo bwo kubika amakuru bwemewe n'ikoranabuhanga.

signUp.title: Iyandikishe
signUp.desc: Fungura konti yawe mu minota mike ukoresheje amakuru shingiro.

approved.title: Emezwaho
approved.desc: Umuyobozi asuzuma kandi akemeza konti yawe.

accounts.title: Fungura konti
accounts.desc: Fungura konti zo kuzigama, zisanzwe cyangwa fixed.

transact.title: Kora ibikorwa
transact.desc: Shyiraho, bukura kandi wohereze amafaranga mu buryo bwizewe.

pricing.title: Ibigize igiciro cyoroshye
pricing.subtitle: Guhindura hagati y'ubwigice bwa buri kwezi n'umwaka nta kubigira aho mucira.

checkout.title: Uzuza ubwishyu bwawe
checkout.subtitle: Checkout yawe ya Paddle yizewe irimo gukururwa hepfo.
checkout.loadingBody: Turimo gutegura urupapuro rwawe rwo kwishyura rwizewe.
checkout.errorBody: Ntabwo twashoboye gukurura widget yo kwishyura.
